label: End-of-episode D2 with low value, mainly on reaching S2
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (99.7% of mass at ep_trial 90-99; nothing before trial 80). It fires only when the value head is low (all activations have value < 5.22, 97% of mass < 4), i.e. when the agent expects little future reward near the episode end. Within that, it prefers trials that reach S2 (90% of mass; the S2 state input at D2) and trials after an unrewarded previous trial (89% of mass), and it fires more often toward later trials of the window. The top activations are S2 reached after unrewarded trials late in the episode. Coarse predicate D2 & ep_trial>=90 gets ~99% recall but 14% precision; adding value<3.5 and state==S2 gives dev F1 0.64 (P 0.60, R 0.68, mass recall 0.78). It never fires at D1 or GO, or before trial 80. The predicate uses only the observed D2 state input and the model value output, no future variables.
